site.audience: general consumers seeking trusted health and wellness information

brief.title: WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions.
brief.goal: Establish trust as a leading health information resource, drive newsletter signups, and guide users to explore health topics, tools, and curated content.

pages.objective: Serve as the main entry point showcasing featured health content, trending articles, interactive tools, and trust signals to engage visitors and encourage exploration.

interactions.trigger: Click on main navigation menu items (Health Conditions, Wellness, Tools, etc.)
interactions.expected: Dropdown mega-menu expands showing subcategories and links

interactions.trigger: Click on category tabs (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, Product Reviews, Recipes, Skin Care)
interactions.expected: Article grid below updates to show articles matching the selected category

interactions.trigger: Click left/right arrow buttons on health topics section
interactions.expected: Health topic cards scroll horizontally to reveal more topics

interactions.trigger: Enter email and click Join Now button
interactions.expected: Email is submitted for newsletter subscription

interactions.trigger: Automatic scrolling ticker in the credibility bar
interactions.expected: Stats about medical reviewers, years of experience, and monthly readers scroll continuously

data_display.description: A scrolling ticker bar displaying key trust and credibility metrics about the platform's medical review process and reach.
